To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new magnetic nanocomposite, Fe3O4 @ SiO2 - MWCNT, was synthesized and applied in the preconcentration, extraction, and determination of OPPs.
a new Fe3O4/SiO2/MWCNT nanocomposites were synthesized by CVD and used as a MSPE adsorbent to extract and determine selected OPPs in water.
a novel Fe3O4-SiO2-MWCMT nanocomposite was developed by chemical vapour deposition.

the synthesis, characterization, and use of a new magnetic adsorbent for extraction and determination of OPPs.
the preparation of Fe3O4 @SiO2-MCNTs nanocomposite by CVD method, which is a simple, fast, and cost-effective technique.
the synthesis and characterization of Fe3O4 @SiO2-MWNCT nanocomposite and its application for the extraction and determination of OPPs.

the developed Fe3O4-SiO2-MWCNt adsorbent was successfully synthesized by chemical vapour deposition method.
the newly synthesized magnetic nanocomposite was successfully applied in the extraction of selected OPP from water samples.
the developed method was successfully used to determine OPPs in real water samples.

the newly synthesized nanocomposite is a good candidate for the extraction of OPPs from aqueously media.
the synthesized Fe3O@SiO2@MWCNT nanocomposites are efficient adsorbents for the removal of OPPs from aqueoussamples.
the Fe3O4-SiO2@MWCNT nanocomposites are promising materials that can be used for the removal of OPPs from water samples.

the newly developed Fe3O4-SiO2-MWCnt nanocomposite can serve as a promising adsorbent for preconcentration of selected OPPs in water.
